title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Center on 1984-12-29
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) ->Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/FujiMetal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Good front‑of‑house (FOB) recording captures a solid yet unremarkable 1984 show.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its very good FOB sound, offering clear and balanced audio that Deadheads appreciate. The performance itself is described as a typical ’84 set – pleasant but nothing that truly dazzles. Overall the tape is enjoyable thanks to the strong mix despite the show’s average nature.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed positive review highlights excellent FOB sound and a decent performance; limited data leads to a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very nice front‑of‑house (FOB) mix, clear and well‑balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1984 set; solid playing but nothing spectacular.
